title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Health Mission (ABDM):
summary: Ayushman Bharat Digital Health Mission (ABDM): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Objective: Digitizing healthcare services across India
ABHA ID (14-digit): Unique health identification for citizens
Unified Health Interface (UHI): Standardized platform for data exchange
100 Microsite Projects: Local digital health promotion
Interoperability: Seamless data sharing across sectors
Health Data Security: Privacy-compliant management of records
